text:
Samir: Quick q — can we tighten the oncall pass/triage sync? Current 45m feels long. Thinking two short blocks (one morning, one late-afternoon) that combine a ~15m handoff + ~15m focused triage. @Maya @Kevin any strong objections?

Maya: +1 on shorter. Morning overlap with EU/US is easier. Suggest 09:30 and 16:30 local PT. Keep a rotating escalation attendee (SRE lead) on each slot.

Kevin: Prefer 15m handoff, 20m triage if there are multiple active incidents. Timezones are rough — maybe alternate the morning slot to be slightly earlier on Tue/Thu for APAC.

triage-bot: Incident #342 — P2 memory leak on svc-cache still open. Owner: Olivia. Last update: memory spike after batch job, mitigation: restart worker.

Olivia: I'll post a short incident summary before the morning sync with steps taken and next actions. Can take owner for the morning triage if needed.

Samir: Proposed agenda snippet (keeps it tight):
```
- Quick rollcall (who's oncall / escalation) — 1m
- Handoff highlights (what changed since last pass) — 3m
- Open incidents (3m per active; one person gives one-line summary + blocking action)
- Immediate mitigations / who will do what — 5m
- Follow-ups / owners / async threads link — 2m
```

Kevin: I'll cover escalation duties for morning slot next week. @Samir can you update the calendar invite and attach a meeting-notes doc?

Maya: I'll add an async template to the invite so people can paste incident bullets beforehand (status, impact, mitigation, owner). Also add an opt-out rule: if there are zero open incidents and no pages in last 60m, the triage part gets skipped.

Olivia: Sounds good. I'll add the mitigation temp commands/snippets to the incident page so the handoff can be copy/paste.

Samir: Cool. Can we make cadence concrete: 09:30 (15m handoff + 15m triage) and 16:30 (same) weekdays? If APAC folks can't make morning, evening will cover overlap. :eyes:

Li Wei: Morning 09:30 is tough from APAC. 16:30 works better for me. If it's critical, we'll join via async bridge + leave short notes.

Maya: Okay — keep both slots, mark 16:30 as APAC-friendly. We'll rotate the escalation lead so someone is reachable across zones.

triage-bot: Calendar event created: "oncall-briefs" — https://calendar.company/internal/events/0xabc123 (recurring weekdays).

Samir: Thanks all — I'll update invites, post the agenda + template, and create a short checklist in the runbook (tokens to check, active rollbacks, outstanding pages). If anyone wants to be escalation lead next week reply here. :thumbsup:
